outcome: access to prenatal care (first trimester prenatal care, Medicaid-paid births)
racial disparities in teen birth incidence
cohort: Births to mothers aged 13-19 in Pennsylvania during two periods: 2008-2012 (pre-ACA) and 2015-2018 (post-ACA).
finding: The implementation of the ACA contributed to decreased teen birth rates in Pennsylvania and reduced racial disparities in the incidence of teen births.
mod_finding: There was a reduction in Cesarean sections from the pre-ACA to post-ACA period.
